differs.mechanic: Payments leave a small quincunx through planned exits and ride their own tracks across the page into wide bins, where they stack as dots, instead of a switch flipping mid-run and moving the flow inside one big board.
differs.layout: The pegboard shrinks to the top right corner and the bins become a full-width histogram with a target line, with the copy and a headline figure in a top band, replacing the board-on-the-right, copy-on-the-left hero.
differs.data: A distribution: a share per route counted from the 200 payments that landed, landing exactly on the content's shares, against a target share, instead of a live rate of the last 24 payments.
differs.moment: The last payments drop into the bins, D and E stand above the dashed target line and every share settles: 4, 6, 10, 38 and 42%, with 80% sent to 95%+ processors.

blurb: Payments drop through a small pegboard and ride their tracks into full-width bins, so each route's share is counted from the payments that landed.
